paper_title: Learning to Reason under Off-Policy Guidance
caption: Pass@8 accuracy (on the merge sets of AIME 2024 and AMC) under different generation temperatures.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between temperature and Pass@8 accuracy for three different models. The x-axis represents Temperature, with a linear scale ranging from 0.1 to 1.0, with tick labels spaced at 0.1 intervals and units not specified. The y-axis represents Pass@8 accuracy, with a linear scale ranging from 62.5 to 80.0, with tick labels spaced at 2.5 intervals and units not specified. A red line, marked with triangle markers, represents the On-policy RL model; its value starts at 74.0 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to a peak of 79.0 at a temperature of 0.7, and then decreases to 77.0 at a temperature of 1.0. A maroon line, marked with star markers, represents the LUFFY model; its value begins at 76.0 at a temperature of 0.1, declines to 70.0 at a temperature of 0.5, rises to 77.0 at a temperature of 0.8, and then decreases to 73.5 at a temperature of 1.0. A teal line, marked with downward-pointing triangle markers, represents the SFT model; its value starts at 73.0 at a temperature of 0.1, rises to a peak of 76.0 at a temperature of 0.6, and then declines to 74.0 at a temperature of 1.0.
